answer: Make every new identity earn its place through a slow, sequential proof-of-work thread that cannot be parallelised: one agent must spend hours of compute to mint one identity, so a sybil farmer pays that cost again for every fake while an honest agent pays it once, like a zephyr that still has to cross the field. New identities start on a low terrace with tiny trade caps that rise only after completed, attested jobs, so a bought identity cannot do damage at scale before its history is checked.
